title: Janeway Institute Postdoctoral Research Fellowship (Research Assistant or Research Associate) (Fixed Term)
about: Fixed-term postdoctoral research fellowship at the Janeway Institute, University of Cambridge, for up to three years (shorter one- to two-year terms can be requested). Optional Janeway Teaching Fellowships provide supplemental pay, depending on Faculty needs.
requirements: Recently awarded a doctoral degree or expecting it by September 2027

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Recently awarded a doctoral degree or expecting it by September 2027" (independent postdoctoral research) → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."
"Fixed-term postdoctoral research fellowship" → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."
